title: Mxl nn_block weights sidecar
description: Trained weight/bias values for one nn_block, referenced by that block's weights_ref (kinetic-model.schema.json / ode-model.schema.json). Kept as a separate file from the model it belongs to: weight values carry no kinetic/biological meaning the way parameters do, and keeping them out of the model file keeps that file diffable and git-friendly regardless of a block's size. One layer's weight matrix has shape [out_features, in_features] (PyTorch/equinox-native; a Keras-backed consumer must transpose on import/export) and its bias vector has shape [out_features].

^w[0-9]+$.description: Weight matrix for one layer (1-indexed, matching the corresponding nnBlock.layers position), shape [out_features, in_features].

^b[0-9]+$.description: Bias vector for one layer (1-indexed, matching the corresponding nnBlock.layers position), shape [out_features].
